=== Possible James Glasgow and father David, Kelso militia list, 1798 ===
James Glasgow, son to David Glasgow, is named in the Kelso parish militia ballot list accompanying a Jedburgh notice dated 29 September 1798.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/395735887/ The Caledonian Mercury, 1798-10-04, p.1].</ref>

The entry expressly identifies the listed James as David’s son; it does not say "junior". David is described with a weaving descriptor whose exact reading remains qualified. Selection in a militia ballot does not prove completed service or identify James’s mother.

This may concern [[Glasgow-1222]]. For James, Exact recorded 25 December 1777 Kelso birth and later Edinburgh death fit this 1798 James. No individual militia identifier proves assignment; the public father link is tree-derived only.
